title: Disabled account
description: Unused-code / security rule — accounts that are disabled. Stale disabled accounts should be removed to keep the security surface clean.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Disabled accounts accumulate and obscure who really has access.
rule.remediation: Delete accounts that are no longer needed instead of leaving them disabled.
